title: Business Development Executive
description:
We are currently working with an established and reputable main contractor to recruit a Business Development Executive to support its continued growth and strengthen its position across key construction sectors.

With a strong track record the business delivers a diverse range of construction, refurbishment, new-build and specialist projects across London, the South East. Its portfolio includes education, healthcare, commercial, residential, heritage and community projects, underpinned by a commitment to quality, client relationships and successful project delivery.

This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially minded and proactive Business Development Executive to join an established construction business, helping identify new opportunities, develop relationships and contribute to its ongoing growth.

The Role

Working closely with the business development and pre-construction teams, you will play a key role in identifying new business opportunities, developing relationships with prospective clients and consultants, and supporting the company's wider growth strategy.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Identifying and developing new business opportunities across relevant construction sectors.
- Building and maintaining relationships with clients, architects, consultants, quantity surveyors and other key industry contacts.
- Researching forthcoming construction projects, procurement opportunities and potential routes to market.
- Monitoring public-sector frameworks, tender portals and project pipelines to identify suitable opportunities.
- Supporting the preparation of PQQs, tender submissions, presentations and other pre-construction documentation.
- Arranging and attending client meetings, networking events and industry functions to strengthen the company's market presence.
- Maintaining an accurate CRM system, recording client interactions and tracking potential opportunities.
- Working collaboratively with estimating, pre-construction and operational teams to support successful business development activity.
- Monitoring market trends, competitor activity and client requirements to identify opportunities for future growth.

The Ideal Candidate

We are keen to hear from candidates with a background in business development, sales, client relationship management or bid coordination, ideally within the construction or wider built environment sector.

You will be a confident communicator with strong relationship-building skills and a proactive approach to identifying and developing new opportunities.

The successful candidate will ideally demonstrate:
- Experience in a business development, sales or client-facing role.
- An understanding of the construction industry and its procurement processes.
- The ability to research projects, identify decision-makers and develop new client relationships.
- Strong written communication skills, with experience contributing to proposals, presentations or tender submissions.
- Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.
- A commercially aware mindset, with the confidence to engage with clients and industry professionals at different levels.
- A motivated, professional and collaborative approach.

If you are an ambitious Business Development Executive looking for your next opportunity within the construction sector, we would be keen to hear from you.

Please submit your CV for a confidential discussion about this opportunity.

title: Internal Sales Development Representative
company: Room at the Top Recruitment - Agency - Permanent
description:
We are thrilled to offer a new and exciting opportunity for an Internal Sales Development Representative to join our well-established and successful client located in Hertfordshire. As our client continues to grow, they are investing in their sales function to expand and strengthen existing relationships and identify new business opportunities.

This is a newly created position offering an exciting opportunity to make a direct contribution to the growth of our business. As an Internal Sales Development Representative, you will focus on identifying prospective corporate customers, generating new business opportunities and re-engaging businesses that have previously used our services. Through proactive outbound calling, targeted prospect research and relationship building, you will introduce our services to potential customers and develop a strong pipeline of opportunities for our sales team and local branch managers. This is a great opportunity to grow with the business as the sales function develops.

This is a permanent role offering a hybrid working arrangement of 4 days from home and 1 day in the office. The hours are 8am-5pm, Monday-Friday. The role offers a competitive salary of £28,000-£32,000 depending on experience plus commission, performance related bonus and incentives.

Key Responsibilities
- High-Volume Prospecting: Maintain strong daily outbound phone activity to generate new corporate leads and introduce our services to local businesses.
- Lead Generation & Data Sourcing: Identify and map out prospective local businesses within our operational delivery radius.
- Qualification & Discovery: Uncover fleet requirements, short-term rental needs, and vehicle pain points through concise phone discovery.
- Meeting Booking: Secure qualified phone, virtual, or in-person meetings for our Business Development team and Local Branch Managers.
- Account Opening: Guide interested businesses through opening local corporate credit/trade accounts with us.
- Processing Dormant Leads: Contacting clients with dormant or inactive accounts to win back their business/account.
- CRM & Activity Management: Accurately track all daily dials, call notes, pipeline updates, and upcoming follow-ups in our CRM.

Key Requirements and Experience
- Experience: Previous experience in outbound sales, telemarketing, lead generation, or account development (B2 B experience in vehicle rental, fleet management, logistics, or local service sales is an advantage, but not essential).
- Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a confident, persuasive phone manner.
- Proactive Mindset: Self-motivated, resilient, and driven by achieving and exceeding target activity levels.
- Relationship Building: Ability to connect quickly with business managers, fleet directors, and procurement leads.
- Commercial Awareness: Ability to understand customer needs quickly and articulate how corporate vehicle credit accounts add value to their business.
- Local Knowledge: Basic local knowledge of our surrounding areas is required. This is to ensure they connect with local businesses on common ground.
- We use Google Workspace for communications and training given on use of our in-house bespoke CRM.

Additional benefits include:
- 20 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, increasing to 22 days after two years and 23 days after five years.
- Company laptop & phone
- Workplace pension, subject to scheme terms and eligibility requirements.
- Employee Recognition Award.
- Employee Referral Scheme.
- Bike 2 Work Scheme.

Due to the high volume of applications we receive, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. If you do not hear from us, please assume your application has not been successful on this occasion. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best of luck in your job search.

title: Sales Executive
description:
Sales Executive

Watford Office-Based Monday-Friday

38,000 Basic Salary ( 50,000 OTE) 25 Days Holiday + 8 Bank Holidays Free On-Site Parking

Ready to turn opportunities into success?

Are you a proactive, commercially minded sales professional who loves winning new business, building relationships and seeing the results of your hard work reflected in your earnings?

We're looking for an ambitious Sales Executive to join a growing business with big plans for expansion. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys picking up the phone, opening doors with new customers, and turning prospects into long-term, profitable relationships.

You'll play a key role in developing new business across Ireland, working closely with a field-based Business Development Manager to unlock untapped opportunities, reactivate lapsed accounts and build a loyal customer base.

With investment already made in local stock and a next-day delivery service available to Irish customers, you'll have a compelling proposition to take to market, and plenty of opportunity to make your mark!

What will you be doing?

This is a hands-on, new-business sales role where your energy, organisation, and ability to build rapport will make all the difference.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Winning new business: Contact new prospects and re-engage lapsed customers, taking opportunities from the first conversation through to their first order and beyond.
- Building relationships: Develop trust with customers, understand their needs and turn one-off orders into long-term trading relationships.
- Proactive prospecting: Make outbound calls and send targeted emails, follow up quotations, and identify opportunities to generate sales.
- Managing incoming leads: Qualify website enquiries, campaign responses and event leads, ensuring promising opportunities are followed up quickly.
- Supporting field sales: Work closely with the Business Development Manager, arranging customer visits, preparing relevant information and following up afterwards.
- Developing the Irish market: Promote the available product range, make the most of local stock availability and provide customers with accurate pricing and delivery information.
- Managing your pipeline: Keep customer information, quotations, and opportunities up to date within the CRM system

Requirements

We're looking for someone who is motivated by targets, enjoys speaking to people and takes pride in turning opportunities into results.

You'll ideally be:
- Confident and persuasive, with excellent communication skills.
- Proactive and resilient, comfortable picking up the phone and initiating conversations.
- Commercially minded, with the ability to ask the right questions and understand customer requirements.
- Organised and reliable, with strong follow-up skills and attention to detail.
- Motivated by achieving targets and earning performance-related rewards.
- A team player who communicates well, shares information and takes ownership of their work.
- Comfortable using CRM systems and managing a busy sales pipeline.

Experience in B2 B sales, trade sales or business development would be a real advantage. Knowledge of construction, access equipment or utilities sectors would also be beneficial, although a strong sales attitude and the desire to succeed are just as important.

Benefits
- 38,000 basic salary
- 50,000 OTE with performance-related bonus and company profit share
- 25 days' annual leave plus 8 bank holidays
- Free on-site parking
- A friendly, supportive working environment where teamwork matters
- A Monday-to-Friday working pattern, based in the Watford office
- The opportunity to take ownership of a sales territory and make a genuine commercial impact
- The chance to develop your skills and progress within an ambitious, growth-focused business

Ready to take the next step?

If you're hungry for success, enjoy the challenge of winning new customers and want to join a friendly team where you can make a real difference, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and take the next step in your sales career!
